units.source_text: 她身穿元禄袖［元禄袖，一种仿元禄年间（１６８８—１７０３）流行的窄袖缀金银细丝花纹的和服。］的华丽夹衣，

en.t: She was wearing a gorgeous lined kimono with Genroku sleeves [Genroku sleeves are narrow sleeves modeled on those popular during the Genroku era (1688-1703), decorated with fine gold and silver thread patterns],

units.source_text: 披着一件黑领睡衣，系上了窄腰带。

en.t: with a night robe edged in a black collar over it, and a narrow sash tied around her waist.

units.source_text: 因此看不见衬衫的领子，醉得连赤脚的脚板都泛红了，好像要躲藏起来似地缩着身子。

en.t: Because of this, the collar of her underrobe could not be seen; she was so drunk that even the soles of her bare feet were flushed red, and she drew herself in as if trying to hide.

units.source_text: 这副模样显得特别可爱。

en.t: That appearance made her seem especially charming.
